name: Cable Curl
summary: A curl using a low cable pulley that keeps constant tension on the biceps through the whole range of motion.
setup: Attach a straight bar or rope to the low pulley and select a light to moderate weight.
Stand facing the stack, feet hip-width apart, and take the bar with an underhand grip.
Step back slightly so there is tension in the cable, elbows at your sides.
execution: Curl the handle up by bending only at the elbows.
Squeeze at the top without leaning back.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight, keeping tension on the cable.
Stay upright and do not let the stack rest between reps.
mistakes: Leaning back to lift the weight: reduce the load and brace the core.
Elbows drifting forward: keep them at your sides.
Letting the stack drop on the way down: lower the handle under control.
Shrugging the shoulders: keep them down and relaxed.
